name: Wolf
desc: Night silhouette wolf built from layered cut-paper — prowls with a stepping gait, sits, or rears its muzzle to a rising moon halo and howls cold breath-fog into the dark.

energy.doc: motion amplitude: gait swing, bob, tail, breath

pose.doc: prowl=stalking gait, sit=haunches, howl=muzzle up, trot=quick step

style.doc: aesthetic: layered cut-paper w/ mat edge + drop-shadow / pure black silhouette (abstract, no interior) / high-contrast linocut relief w/ carved white / 2-ink riso misregistration / dusk duotone gradient

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: roam steady prowl, hunt slow crouch-cycles, howl rears to a rising swelling moon
